sectors.implications: Short-term sentiment shock but JPMorgan advises against chasing sell-off; AI capex cycle may face 1-2 quarter pause before resuming

sectors.implications: Inflationary pressure intensifies, supporting Fed hike thesis; energy equities and pipeline stocks benefit; transport/consumer discretionary pressured

sectors.implications: Bond market repricing signals Fed pivot to hikes; high-yield spreads widening; rate-sensitive sectors (REITs, utilities) under pressure

sectors.implications: Precious metals pressured by rising real yields but long-term supply constraints support structural bull case; tungsten strategic value rising

AI sentiment inflection: Industry leaders calling for slowdown, triggering tech rotation
Fed pivot to hikes: Bond market leading, equity market lagging; rate-sensitive assets under pressure
US fiscal credibility: Bessent vs bond traders; $1.5T defense budget; borrowing cost concerns
Supply chain resilience: Tungsten, critical minerals, Western sourcing priority
Trade dynamics: China soybean progress vs US-Canada trade war; Pakistan/India inflation
Consumer squeeze: High diesel, rising rates, retail bankruptcies
Defense spending supercycle: Geopolitical risk driving structural budget increase

Shorten duration; favor floating-rate instruments; lock in CD rates at 4.35% before further hikes; reduce leverage
Avoid chasing AI sell-off per JPMorgan; wait for 1-2 quarter digestion; favor AI-adjacent infrastructure over pure-play model developers

Overweight energy, commodities; underweight consumer discretionary; monitor India/Pakistan inflation as global spillover
Favor domestic-supply-chain companies; monitor Xi visit outcomes; Canada exposure via Carney's investment pitch
Tighten credit spreads; avoid sub-investment-grade with near-term maturities; monitor Ferretti, UPS signals

opportunities.rationale: Saudi pipeline restart uncertainty creates 2-4 week oil premium; pipeline stocks offer 6-8% yields with less volatility

opportunities.rationale: Structural 3-5 year tailwind from geopolitical risk premium and Western supply chain reshoring

opportunities.recommendation: Do not chase AI sell-off; wait for 2-3 week digestion then re-enter quality AI infrastructure names
opportunities.rationale: JPMorgan explicitly advises against chasing; Amodei/Altman warnings are sentiment, not fundamental; capex cycle intact

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim high-yield credit and avoid sub-investment-grade with 2026-27 maturities

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge equity portfolio with energy and gold; reduce consumer discretionary exposure

defensive_moves.recommendation: Avoid NuScale, MARA Holdings, and other momentum/small-cap AI-adjacent names in current environment
defensive_moves.rationale: MARA double-downgraded by JPMorgan; NuScale catalyst unclear; small-caps hit hardest in risk-off

defensive_moves.recommendation: Monitor UPS dividend yield as leading indicator of logistics/consumer stress; reduce if yield stays elevated
defensive_moves.rationale: Unusually high yield signals market pricing in earnings decline, not a buying opportunity

market_outlook.short_term: Bearish-to-neutral. Oil spike + AI sentiment shock + Fed hike expectations create 2-4 week headwind for equities. JPMorgan sees oversold conditions but no bottom yet. Expect Dow/Nasdaq to test support before stabilizing. Energy and defense outperform. Bond yields likely to push 10Y above current levels before pausing.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive. AI capex cycle intact despite sentiment pause; defense supercycle structural; critical minerals reshoring multi-year theme. Key risk is if oil stays elevated >6 months, forcing aggressive Fed tightening that triggers recession. China soybean progress and Xi visit offer trade de-escalation catalyst. US fiscal path remains wildcard.
